# betterado_serviceendpoint_servicefabric (Resource)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_endpoint` (String) Client connection endpoint for the cluster. Prefix the value with 'tcp://';. This value overrides the publish profile.
- `project_id` (String)
- `service_endpoint_name` (String)

### Optional

- `azure_active_directory` (Block List, Max: 1) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--azure_active_directory))
- `certificate` (Block List, Max: 1) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--certificate))
- `description` (String)
- `none` (Block List, Max: 1) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--none))
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `authorization` (Map of String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedblock--azure_active_directory"></a>
### Nested Schema for `azure_active_directory`

Required:

- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password for the Azure Active Directory account.
- `server_certificate_lookup` (String)
- `username` (String) Specify an Azure Active Directory account.

Optional:

- `server_certificate_common_name` (String) The common name(s) of the cluster's certificate(s). This is used to verify the identity of the cluster. This value overrides the publish profile. Separate multiple common names with a comma (',')
- `server_certificate_thumbprint` (String) The thumbprint(s) of the cluster's certificate(s). This is used to verify the identity of the cluster. This value overrides the publish profile. Separate multiple thumbprints with a comma (',')


<a id="nestedblock--certificate"></a>
### Nested Schema for `certificate`

Required:

- `client_certificate` (String, Sensitive) Base64 encoding of the cluster's client certificate file.
- `server_certificate_lookup` (String)

Optional:

- `client_certificate_password` (String, Sensitive) Password for the certificate.
- `server_certificate_common_name` (String) The common name(s) of the cluster's certificate(s). This is used to verify the identity of the cluster. This value overrides the publish profile. Separate multiple common names with a comma (',')
- `server_certificate_thumbprint` (String) The thumbprint(s) of the cluster's certificate(s). This is used to verify the identity of the cluster. This value overrides the publish profile. Separate multiple thumbprints with a comma (',')
